English Explanation: Name of the railway line or corridor on which the train service operates.
Identifier assigned to a specific train service.
Origin station of the adjacent railway segment.
Destination station of the adjacent railway segment.
Distance between the origin and destination stations of the segment, measured in kilometres.
Scheduled departure time at the origin station, expressed as HH:MM.
Scheduled arrival time at the destination station, expressed as HH:MM.
Scheduled headway between adjacent train services in the same period, measured in minutes.
Second-class ticket fare for the corresponding segment or timetable record, expressed in CNY.
First-class ticket fare for the corresponding segment or timetable record, expressed in CNY.
Calendar date to which the timetable record applies.
Classification of the operating date, such as weekday, weekend, or holiday.
Numeric identifier of the operating time period.
Start and end times that delimit the operating period, expressed as HH:MM–HH:MM.
Peak-condition category assigned to the operating period, such as Peak, Shoulder, or Off-peak.
Direction of train travel along the railway corridor, determined from station mileage.
Cumulative mileage position of the origin station along the railway corridor, measured in kilometres.
Cumulative mileage position of the destination station along the railway corridor, measured in kilometres.
Travel time over the segment from departure to arrival, measured in minutes.
Scheduled average speed over the segment, calculated from segment distance and running time, in km/h.
Category describing the train service, such as intercity high-speed rail.
Model or type designation of the electric multiple unit operating the train service.
Number of carriages in the trainset.
Maximum passenger capacity of one train, expressed in passengers.
Estimated number of passengers boarding for this train segment.
Estimated number of passengers alighting for this train segment.
Estimated passenger load travelling on the adjacent railway segment.
Ratio of estimated segment passenger load to train capacity.
Passenger-distance volume, calculated as segment passenger flow multiplied by segment distance, in passenger-kilometres.
Estimated second-class passenger revenue for the segment, expressed in CNY.
Train dwell time at the origin station before departure, measured in minutes.
Train dwell time at the destination station after arrival, measured in minutes.
Identifier of the platform assigned to the train for the relevant station or segment.
Identifier of the track assigned to the train for the relevant station or segment.
Estimated traction electricity consumed over the segment, measured in kWh.
Estimated magnitude of potential delay risk for the record, measured in minutes.
Categorical level of passenger crowding risk, such as Low, Medium, or High.
Representative weather category associated with the record.
Y/N indicator showing whether the record is affected by a maintenance window.
Y/N indicator showing whether an external operational disruption is present.
